Maybe he's reconnecting with his Icelandic heritage or feels that Thor is a better reflection of who he is now. On the other hand, I've been calling him Tim for a decade, and it's going to take some time to get used to calling him Thor. I don't want to ruin our friendship over something like this, but I also don't want to pretend to be okay with it if it's causing me stress. I also need to consider the impact this change will have on our relationship. I also need to be prepared for the possibility that he might not be understanding, and that could strain our relationship. But I have to weigh that risk against the importance of respecting his wishes and maintaining mutual respect in our friendship. Overall, I think the best approach is to acknowledge his preference, express my need for time to adjust, and commit to making the effort to call him Thor.
